issues.description: The template defines apply_single_qubit_gate with parameters (gate, state, site) while the problem statement's function list and the solution implementation use the signature (state, gate, site). This parameter order mismatch can confuse students about the expected argument order and cause subtle bugs when they follow the solution or tests that expect the state-first ordering.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the problem statement and solution by changing the template function signature to def apply_single_qubit_gate(state, gate, site). Update any documentation/comments in tensor_networks.py to reflect the state-first parameter order so students have a consistent expected interface.
